AccountSpark.description:
One Worth row: the balance, when it was last confirmed, and the memory behind
its sparkline and long-press history sheet.
AccountSpark.title: AccountSpark

AnchorIn.description:
A user-confirmed balance. `at` defaults to now; anchors can be backdated
(balance derivation handles any anchor time exactly).
AnchorIn.title: AnchorIn

BudgetTrail.description:
The evidence behind one budget row: what the last months actually cost (the
sparkline), whether the line has been held and for how long, and the daily
cumulative climb against an even pace.
BudgetTrail.title: BudgetTrail

CategorySlice.description: Where it went. A null category is the uncategorised pile, not a total.
CategorySlice.title: CategorySlice

DayFacts.description:
What the rest of the box already knows about a day, so the page arrives
half-written.
DayFacts.title: DayFacts

FocusRecord.description: All-time, completed work only: what the best of it has ever looked like.
FocusRecord.title: FocusRecord

GoalView.description:
Port of GoalView: done/remaining over goal-tagged txns, plus the ETA the
setup ritual answers back ('at ₹X a month you'd reach this by …').
GoalView.title: GoalView

JournalIn.description: The day itself is the path param, never the payload — one entry per IST day.
JournalIn.title: JournalIn

MoodMoneyOut.description:
Whether rough days or bright ones cost more. Null on the month view when
there isn't enough to say — the book would rather stay quiet than guess.
MoodMoneyOut.title: MoodMoneyOut

OccurrenceOut.description:
One concrete observance of an event inside a queried window: the stored row
plus the resolved calendar date (a yearly event yields one per year).
OccurrenceOut.title: OccurrenceOut

PinnedSuggestion.description: A repeat that has earned a pin and doesn't have one yet.
PinnedSuggestion.title: PinnedSuggestion

PinnedUse.description:
A pin and how often it has actually been stamped — 'stamped 14 times'.
Matched on title + amount, so a hand-typed repeat counts as the same stroke.
PinnedUse.title: PinnedUse

QuietWeekOut.description: Only present when the month had a quiet week worth pointing at.
QuietWeekOut.title: QuietWeekOut

RecentAmount.description: 'usually ₹40' — a figure this category keeps being written for.
RecentAmount.title: RecentAmount

TitleSuggestion.description: Autocomplete carrying category/account memory (port of TxnRepo.suggestTitles).
TitleSuggestion.title: TitleSuggestion
